verdict.rationale: Azure's Terraform docs cite a first-party capability to export existing resources to HCL, an open declarative format that helps move infrastructure definitions elsewhere. That covers only resource configuration, not 'all of my data', and nothing in the pack documents bulk data export or an exit path. missing for 10: export of actual data (storage, database, log contents) in open formats, a documented full-account or tenant export, a documented exit or offboarding path, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
